players.product: Power and distribution transformers and substations (T&D) for grid connection, plus Marathon alternators for data-center energy backup and industrial pumps / ventilation equipment for cooling systems

quarterly_data.signal: WEG Turbinas, together with WEG's operation in India, supplied a turbogenerator (turbine, gearbox and generator) for on-site power to a sugar plant of one of Indonesia's largest corporate groups (not named), delivered in August 2026; it was the customer's first purchase from WEG. WEG says the contract establishes it 'as a leader in the Southeast Asian market'.
